root_cause_label: Incomplete NumPy Deprecation Fix: .pyx Files Not Searched or Fixed
one_sentence_failure_summary: When searching for np.int deprecations at step 57, the agent used 'find . -name "*.py"' and missed the Cython source files (.pyx), so ccomplexity.pyx retained the deprecated n.int reference and caused the evaluation test to fail.
t_err_evidence: At step 57, the agent searched for n.int occurrences using 'find . -name "*.py" -exec grep -l "n\.int" {} \;', which only finds Python source files and silently skips .pyx Cython source files; ccomplexity.pyx and other .pyx files were never surfaced for the fix.
t_commit_evidence: At step 58, the agent ran 'sed -i "s/n\.int/int/g"' only on the .py files identified in step 57, leaving all .pyx files (including ccomplexity.pyx) unfixed, after which the agent ran tests that passed (18/18) and considered the task complete with no further .pyx inspection.
trigger_explanation: The agent was aware of .pyx Cython source files (found them at step 9), but when performing a comprehensive search for deprecated np.int usage, used the glob pattern '*.py' rather than searching all file types or explicitly including '*.pyx'. This reflects a gap in recognizing that Cython source files can contain NumPy Python-level attribute references (n.int) that are also subject to NumPy 2.x deprecation, separate from the C-level API issues.
